text:
alex: Heads-up — I'm going to push a patch to the Python + TS SDKs tonight to fix signer metadata on wheels. Planning a quiet window at 23:00 PST. Deploy bot will run a staged publish.

release-bot: @channel starting staged publish for refs/heads/main -> tag v2.14.3-canary at 2026-03-21T23:00:00-08:00. Canary cohort: 5% traffic. Logs: https://redwood-internal/release/5109 

maria: Quick question — does this change break older clients? Is this only metadata (wheel tags) or an API-level change?

alex: only metadata in packaging. No runtime import changes. We changed the wheel metadata field `Signer-Identity` that some registries read. Backcompat should be fine.

sam: OK. For safety, can we pin the old signed wheel in the dist-tag `legacy` while canary runs? That way any automated CI that pins latest won't suddenly pick up unsigned variant.

alex: yes. plan: 1) publish canary tag `v2.14.3-canary`; 2) set `latest` -> canary for 24h; 3) set `legacy` -> v2.14.2 for pinned consumers. If we see issues revert `latest` to `legacy`.

jia: Rollback criteria? what metrics/alerts should we watch?

devex-oncall: Watch these: 1) publish-bot queue errors, 2) SDK integration tests failures in main CI, 3) deploybot publish error rate > 1%, 4) telemetry: embedding rate drops or 5xxs on SDK users. If any trigger we stop the rollout and republish `latest` -> v2.14.2.

alex: rollback playbook (short):
```
# revert latest to legacy
npm dist-tag add @redwood/sdk@v2.14.2 latest
twine upload --repository-url <pypi> dist/redwood_sdk-2.14.2-py3-none-any.whl
# notify
```
I'll run the commands if needed, but ping me first.

maria: also add a short deprecation note in the changelog about the metadata change and why we changed the signer field. Small blurb in release notes suffices.

sam: I'll add a line to the developer docs about pinning and the `legacy` dist-tag. Also pushing a small script for CI teams to lock to `legacy` if they rely on signer metadata.

release-bot: publish canary step 2/3: wheels uploaded to staging. No immediate errors.

alex: will wait ~30m on canary, then bump to 50% if no alerts. If everything green after 6 hours we promote to GA. If we see any packaging discrepancy reports from registries (e.g., missing `Signer-Identity`) we will hold and rollback.

jia: Can you drop the commit sha here and the canary tag? I want to add it to the nightly smoke.

alex: commit: c3f9b2a, tag: v2.14.3-canary. Adding to nightly smoke now.

devex-oncall: Noted. I'll monitor deploybot and CI and post any anomalies here. If you want an automated rollback trigger, we can enable the deploybot flag `auto-revert-on-publish-error` for tonight. Thoughts?

sam: Enable it. We should be conservative for packaging changes.

alex: done — turned on `auto-revert-on-publish-error`. Thanks team. I'll post final promote/rollback status when done. :thumbsup:

release-bot: publish complete: canary cohort active. 5% traffic. No publish errors.
